title: EEG: Three-Stim Auditory Oddball and Rest in Acute and Chronic TBI
description: This dataset comprises three-stimulus auditory oddball task and resting-state EEG recordings collected from control participants, individuals with sub-acute mild traumatic brain injury (mTBI), and chronic TBI patients. Data were acquired across multiple sessions spanning acute to chronic post-injury phases, with longitudinal follow-up assessments at approximately 2 and 4 months post-injury for acute/sub-acute groups. The dataset includes comprehensive metadata, analysis scripts, and task implementation code to support reproducible neurophysiological investigations of TBI-related alterations in auditory processing and neural function.
methods_description: EEG data were collected during a three-stimulus auditory oddball task and resting-state conditions. For control and sub-acute mTBI participants, Session 1 occurred 3-14 days post-injury, Session 2 at approximately 2 months (1.5-3 months), and Session 3 at approximately 4 months (3-5 months) following initial assessment. Chronic TBI participants completed a single session. Data were collected between 2016-2018 at the Center for Brain Recovery and Repair at the UNM Health Sciences Center.
